overview: Structure loot is rolled per player, so nobody arrives second. Opening a dungeon chest opens your own copy of it, and the player behind you still gets a first look.

1.1.0: The best chests put a lock in the way: picks that wear as you work them, a difficulty you can set for yourself, and an answer rolled fresh every visit so no lock can be probed and come back to. Picking a masterwork earns an advancement.
Loot chests, and loot minecarts, now stand until an operator breaks one: breaking one used to roll the table onto the ground for whoever swung first and take everyone else's copy with it.
1.0.0: Loot chests open as your own copy, take-only and never unpacked, in the same block with the same lid and the same sound as any other chest.

A gold clasp marks a loot chest nobody has been into and a darkened one marks a chest you have emptied, which is the one thing the game can no longer tell you once loot is per player. Chest minecarts work the same way.
